# Parcel Management Group

> Parcel Management Group (PMG) is a US freight and parcel spend management firm that reduces shipping costs for businesses across small package (UPS and FedEx), less-than-truckload (LTL) and full truckload (FTL) freight. The Small Package Program has no fees, no contract and no cost to the business — PMG is paid a commission on the program itself, never by the shipper.

Serving shippers nationwide from Ventura, California. Registered freight broker: USDOT 3266041, MC 1030328. Associate member of the Running Industry Association.

## Services

- [Freight and parcel services](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/services/): small package discounts for UPS and FedEx, LTL and full truckload freight, and refund recovery audits.
- Small Package Discounts: a nationwide small-package discount program for UPS and FedEx shippers, positioned to surpass typical association and group discount programs. Free to the business; enrollment is fast and billing runs through a third-party partner.
- Less-Than-Truckload (LTL): a full LTL dispatch team providing competitive rates with hands-on service on every load.
- Full Truckload (FTL): end-to-end truckload shipping for shippers needing dedicated capacity.
- Refund Recovery Audit: proactive auditing of UPS and FedEx accounts to identify eligible refunds from late or unused shipments, with PMG filing and managing the claims.

## Guides

- [What Is a Freight Broker?](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/what-is-a-freight-broker/): a freight broker finds and manages carriers for your freight so you get a clear rate and support. PMG is a registered broker in Ventura, CA.
- [What Is LTL Shipping?](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/what-is-ltl-shipping/): LTL shipping moves freight that fills part of a truck. You share space and pay for the space you use. PMG is a registered broker in Ventura, CA.
- [LTL vs FTL Shipping](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/ltl-vs-ftl/): LTL shares a truck; FTL uses a full trailer. Pick the mode that fits your freight. PMG is a registered broker in Ventura, CA.
- [LTL Freight Quote](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/ltl-freight-quote/): Need an LTL freight quote? Share freight details with PMG. We compare carriers and send a clear rate. Registered broker in Ventura, CA 93001.
- [What Is Freight Class?](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/what-is-freight-class/): Freight class (NMFC) is the rating that shapes LTL rates. Density, handling, stowability, and liability set the class. PMG is a registered broker in Ventura, CA 93001.
- [How Freight Quoting Works](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/how-freight-quoting-works/): tell PMG what you ship, where it goes, and when you need it. PMG compares carriers and sends a clear quote. Broker versus carrier, and small package versus LTL.
- [Freight Broker vs Carrier](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/freight-broker-vs-carrier/): a freight broker finds and manages carriers for your freight. A carrier owns the trucks or planes. PMG is a registered broker in Ventura, CA.
- [What Is a Parcel Audit?](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/blog/what-is-a-parcel-audit/): what a parcel audit checks, how the weekly process works, the billing errors it finds, and what an audit report should show.
- [Parcel Audit vs Freight Audit](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/blog/parcel-audit-vs-freight-audit/): the differences in shipment profile, error type, claim deadlines and economics, with guidance on which audit a given shipper needs.
- [How to Reduce Shipping Costs When You Ship at Volume](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/blog/reduce-shipping-costs-high-volume/): surcharge control, dimensional weight, service-level mix, parcel-to-LTL mode shifting, rate negotiation and auditing.
- [UPS and FedEx Late Delivery Refunds](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/blog/ups-fedex-late-delivery-refunds/): which FedEx services the money-back guarantee covers as of February 2026, the 15-day claim window, and why most refunds go unclaimed.
- [What Is Dimensional Weight?](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/blog/dimensional-weight/): how UPS and FedEx calculate DIM weight using divisor 139, and how to reduce dimensional-weight charges.
- [How to Track a TForce Freight Shipment](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/blog/tforce-freight-tracking/): tracking by PRO or BOL number, where to find the PRO, why old paperwork says UPGF or UPS Freight, reading scan statuses, and what to do when tracking stalls.
- [How to Track a Forward Air Shipment](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/blog/forward-air-tracking/): tracking by PRO or bill of lading, where the tracking number appears, and how to open a trace when a shipment stops scanning.
- [What Does Prepay and Add Mean in Shipping?](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/blog/prepay-and-add-shipping/): the freight payment term explained, compared against prepaid, collect and third-party billing, with its risks for the buyer. Prepay and add is not an Incoterm.
- [How to Write a Shipping Address](https://www.parcelmanagementgroup.com/blog/how-to-write-a-shipping-address/): correct US address format, what the shipper address means, how to use c/o and attention lines, and why address errors trigger carrier correction fees.

## Key facts

- The Small Package Program is free to the client: no fees, no contract, no cost to your business.
- PMG serves shippers nationally across the United States; it is not a local-only service business.
- Long-standing client concentration in footwear, running and apparel retail, with named client testimonials spanning more than ten years of relationships.
- PMG does not publish specific percentage-savings claims.

- You tell us what you ship, where it goes, and when you need it. We compare carrier options and send a clear quote. For small packages, you can join the free Small Package Program — no fees and no contract.
- A carrier owns the trucks or planes. A broker finds the right carrier for your freight and manages the move. Parcel Management Group is a registered freight broker (USDOT 3266041 · MC 1030328).
- Use small package for boxes that are usually under 150 lbs. Use LTL when you have pallet freight that is too big for parcel but does not need a full truck.
- PMG is based in Ventura, CA 93001 and serves shippers nationwide. Phone: (805) 984-4114.
